variables.description: The external port for accessing the Mealie web interface.
variables.label: Mealie Web Port

variables.description: User ID for the Mealie container. Used by the application internally for file ownership. Set to match the owner of the mounted volume for best permissions.
variables.label: User ID (PUID)

variables.description: Group ID for the Mealie container. Used by the application internally for file ownership. Set to match the group of the mounted volume for best permissions.
variables.label: Group ID (PGID)

variables.description: Specify the timezone for the Mealie container (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Etc/UTC').
variables.label: Timezone
